country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.1001
	title = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.1001.t
	desc = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.1001.d
	picture = GFX_political_deal
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_accept
		ai_chance = { base = 65 }
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_SAU
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_SAU = 1 }
			country_exists = SAU
			SAU = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 1 }
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
			}

			COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
				SAU = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
			}

			NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
			NOT = { has_war_with = SAU }
			SAU = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
			OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_SAU compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			SAU = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_SAU
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_SAU = 1 }
				country_exists = SAU
				SAU = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 1 }
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
				}

				COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
					SAU = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				}

				NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
				NOT = { has_war_with = SAU }
				SAU = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
				OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_SAU compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				SAU = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_SAU
				SAU = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_SAU }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
			}
			SAU = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
					add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
				}
				COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_decline
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
		trigger = {

				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
			}

			COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
				SAU = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
			}

			NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
			NOT = { has_war_with = SAU }
			SAU = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
			OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_SAU compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			SAU = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_SAU
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_SAU = 5 }
				country_exists = SAU
				SAU = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 5 }
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
				}

				COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
					SAU = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				}

				NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
				NOT = { has_war_with = SAU }
				SAU = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
				OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_SAU compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				SAU = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_SAU
				SAU = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_SAU }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
			}
			SAU = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
					add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
				}
				COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_decline
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_SAU
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_SAU = 5 }

					}

				SAU = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }

					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
				}

				COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
					SAU = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				}

				NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
				NOT = { has_war_with = SAU }
				SAU = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
				OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_SAU compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				SAU = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_SAU
				SAU = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_SAU }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
			}
			SAU = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
					add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
				}
				COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_decline
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_SAU
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_SAU = 13 }
			country_exists = SAU

				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 13 }
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }

		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_SAU
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_SAU = 25 }
			country_exists = SAU
			SAU = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 25 }
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_SAU
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_SAU = 25 }
					country_exists = SAU
					SAU = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
						check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 25 }
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
					}
				}
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_SAU
				SAU = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
		}
	}

country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.1026
	title = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.1026.t
	desc = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.1026.d
	picture = GFX_political_deal
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_accept
		ai_chance = { base = 65 }
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_SAU
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_SAU = 26 }
			country_exists = SAU
			SAU = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 26 }
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
			}

			COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
				SAU = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
			}

			NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
			NOT = { has_war_with = SAU }
			SAU = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
			OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_SAU compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			SAU = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_SAU
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_SAU = 26 }
				country_exists = SAU
				SAU = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 26 }
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
				}

				COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
					SAU = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				}

				NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
				NOT = { has_war_with = SAU }
				SAU = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
				OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_SAU compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				SAU = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_SAU
				SAU = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_SAU }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
			}
			SAU = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
					add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
				}
				COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_decline
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_SAU
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_SAU = 26 }
			country_exists = SAU
			SAU = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 26 }
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_SAU
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_SAU = 26 }
					country_exists = SAU
					SAU = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
						check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 26 }
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
					}
				}
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_SAU
				SAU = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_expired
		ai_chance = { base = 0 }
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_SAU
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_SAU = 26 }
				country_exists = SAU

					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending

	title = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.1030.t
	desc = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.1030.d
	picture = GFX_political_deal
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_accept
		ai_chance = { base = 65 }
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_SAU
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_SAU = 30 }
			country_exists = SAU
			SAU = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 30 }
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
			}

			COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
				SAU = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
			}

			NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
			NOT = { has_war_with = SAU }
			SAU = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
			OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_SAU compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			SAU = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_SAU
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_SAU = 30 }
				country_exists = SAU
				SAU = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 30 }
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
				}

				COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
					SAU = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				}

				NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
				NOT = { has_war_with = SAU }
				SAU = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
				OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_SAU compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				SAU = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_SAU
				SAU = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_SAU }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
			}
			SAU = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
					add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
				}
				COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_decline
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_SAU
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_SAU = 30 }

						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
						check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 30 }
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
					}

				SAU = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }

				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting

			NOT = { has_war_with = KUW }
			KUW = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
			OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_KUW compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			KUW = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_KUW
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_KUW = 2 }
				country_exists = KUW
				KUW = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 2 }
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
				}

				COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
					KUW = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				}

				NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
				NOT = { has_war_with = KUW }
				KUW = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
				OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_KUW compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				KUW = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_KUW
				KUW = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_KUW }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
			}
			KUW = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
					add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
				}
				COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
		}
	}

						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
						check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 2 }

		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_KUW
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_KUW = 6 }
			country_exists = KUW
			KUW = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 6 }
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
			}

			COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
				KUW = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
			}

			NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
			NOT = { has_war_with = KUW }
			KUW = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
			OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_KUW compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			KUW = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_KUW
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_KUW = 6 }
				country_exists = KUW
				KUW = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 6 }

				OR = {
					NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
					KUW = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				}

				NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
				NOT = { has_war_with = KUW }
				KUW = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
				OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_KUW compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				KUW = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_KUW
				KUW = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_KUW }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
			}
			KUW = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
					add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
				}
				COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
		}
	}

					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting

country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.2027
	title = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.2027.t
	desc = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.2027.d
	picture = GFX_political_deal
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_accept
		ai_chance = { base = 65 }
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_KUW
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_KUW = 27 }
			country_exists = KUW
			KUW = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 27 }
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
			}

			COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
				KUW = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
			}

			NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
			NOT = { has_war_with = KUW }
			KUW = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
			OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_KUW compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			KUW = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_KUW
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_KUW = 27 }
				country_exists = KUW
				KUW = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 27 }
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
				}

				COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
					KUW = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				}

				NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
				NOT = { has_war_with = KUW }
				KUW = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
				OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_KUW compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				KUW = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_KUW
				KUW = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_KUW }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
			}
			KUW = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
					add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
				}
				COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_decline
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_KUW
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_KUW = 27 }

						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting

			KUW = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }

				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_KUW }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state

			KUW = {

	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_accept

			country_exists = BHR
			BHR = {

				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 3 }
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
			}

			COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
				BHR = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
			}

			NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
			NOT = { has_war_with = BHR }
			BHR = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
			OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_BHR compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			BHR = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_BHR
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_BHR = 3 }
				country_exists = BHR
				BHR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 3 }
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
				}

				COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
					BHR = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				}

				NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
				NOT = { has_war_with = BHR }
				BHR = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
				OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_BHR compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				BHR = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_BHR
				BHR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_BHR }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
			}
			BHR = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
					add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
				}
				COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_decline
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }

						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
						check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 3 }

					}
				}

		name = COLDWAR_GCC_accept
		ai_chance = { base = 65 }
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_BHR
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_BHR = 7 }
			country_exists = BHR
			BHR = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 7 }
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
			}

			COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
				BHR = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
			}

			NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
			NOT = { has_war_with = BHR }
			BHR = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
			OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_BHR compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			BHR = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_BHR
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_BHR = 7 }
				country_exists = BHR
				BHR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 7 }
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
				}

				COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
					BHR = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				}

				NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
				NOT = { has_war_with = BHR }
				BHR = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
				OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_BHR compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				BHR = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_BHR
				BHR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_BHR }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
			}
			BHR = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
					add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
				}
				COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_decline
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_BHR
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_BHR = 7 }
			country_exists = BHR

				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 7 }
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
			}
		}

					check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_BHR = 7 }
					country_exists = BHR
					BHR = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
						check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 7 }
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
					}
				}
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_BHR
				BHR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}

country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.3028
	title = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.3028.t
	desc = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.3028.d
	picture = GFX_political_deal
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_accept
		ai_chance = { base = 65 }
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_BHR
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_BHR = 28 }
			country_exists = BHR
			BHR = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 28 }
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
			}

			COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
				BHR = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
			}

			NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
			NOT = { has_war_with = BHR }
			BHR = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
			OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_BHR compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			BHR = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_BHR
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_BHR = 28 }
				country_exists = BHR
				BHR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 28 }
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
				}

				COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
					BHR = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				}

				NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
				NOT = { has_war_with = BHR }
				BHR = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
				OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_BHR compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				BHR = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_BHR
				BHR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_BHR }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
			}
			BHR = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
					add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
				}
				COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_decline
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_BHR
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_BHR = 28 }

			BHR = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
			OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_BHR compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			BHR = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_BHR
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_BHR = 32 }
				country_exists = BHR
				BHR = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting

					NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
					BHR = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				}

				NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
				NOT = { has_war_with = BHR }
				BHR = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
				OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_BHR compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				BHR = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_BHR
				BHR = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_BHR }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
			}
			BHR = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
					add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
				}
				COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
		}

			QAT = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
			OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_QAT compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			QAT = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_QAT
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_QAT = 4 }

					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting

					NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
					QAT = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				}

				NOT = { has_war_with = QAT }
				QAT = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
				OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_QAT compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				QAT = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_QAT
				QAT = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_QAT }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
			}
			QAT = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
					add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
				}
				COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
		}
	}

		name = COLDWAR_GCC_accept
		ai_chance = { base = 65 }
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_QAT
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_QAT = 8 }
			country_exists = QAT
			QAT = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 8 }
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
			}

			COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
				QAT = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
			}

			NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
			NOT = { has_war_with = QAT }
			QAT = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
			OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_QAT compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			QAT = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_QAT
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_QAT = 8 }
				country_exists = QAT
				QAT = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 8 }
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
				}

				COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
					QAT = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				}

				NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
				NOT = { has_war_with = QAT }
				QAT = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
				OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_QAT compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				QAT = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_QAT
				QAT = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_QAT }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
			}
			QAT = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
					add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
				}
				COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_decline
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }

country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.4029
	title = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.4029.t
	desc = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.4029.d
	picture = GFX_political_deal
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_accept
		ai_chance = { base = 65 }
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_QAT
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_QAT = 29 }
			country_exists = QAT
			QAT = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 29 }
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
			}

			COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
				QAT = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
			}

			NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
			NOT = { has_war_with = QAT }
			QAT = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
			OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_QAT compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			QAT = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_QAT
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_QAT = 29 }
				country_exists = QAT
				QAT = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 29 }
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
				}

				COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
					QAT = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				}

				NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
				NOT = { has_war_with = QAT }
				QAT = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
				OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_QAT compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				QAT = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_QAT
				QAT = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_QAT }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
			}
			QAT = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
					add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
				}
				COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_decline
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
		trigger = {

			check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_QAT = 29 }

					QAT = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
						check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 32 }
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
					}
				}
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_QAT
				QAT = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
		}

country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.5001
	title = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.5001.t
	desc = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.5001.d
	picture = GFX_political_deal
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_accept
		ai_chance = { base = 65 }
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_OMA
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_OMA = 1 }
			country_exists = OMA
			OMA = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 1 }
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
			}

			COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
				OMA = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
			}

			NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
			NOT = { has_war_with = OMA }
			OMA = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
			OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_OMA compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			OMA = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_OMA
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_OMA = 1 }
				country_exists = OMA
				OMA = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 1 }
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
				}

				COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
					OMA = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				}

				NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
				NOT = { has_war_with = OMA }
				OMA = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
				OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_OMA compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				OMA = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_OMA
				OMA = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_OMA }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
			}
			OMA = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
					add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
				}
				COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_decline
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_OMA
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_OMA = 1 }
			country_exists = OMA
			OMA = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 1 }
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_OMA
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_OMA = 1 }
					country_exists = OMA
					OMA = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
						check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 1 }
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
					}
				}
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_OMA
				OMA = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_expired
		ai_chance = { base = 0 }
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_OMA
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_OMA = 1 }
				country_exists = OMA

					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending

	is_triggered_only = yes

		name = COLDWAR_GCC_accept

				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }

			OR = {
				NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
				OMA = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
			}

			NOT = { has_war_with = OMA }
			OMA = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
			OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_OMA compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			OMA = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_OMA
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_OMA = 5 }
				country_exists = OMA
				OMA = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 5 }
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
				}

				COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
					OMA = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				}

				NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
				NOT = { has_war_with = OMA }
				OMA = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
				OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_OMA compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				OMA = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_OMA
				OMA = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_OMA }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
			}
			OMA = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
					add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
				}
				COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
		}
	}

		name = COLDWAR_GCC_decline
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }

					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
				}

				COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
					OMA = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				}

				NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
				NOT = { has_war_with = OMA }
				OMA = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
				OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_OMA compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				OMA = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_OMA
				OMA = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_OMA }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
			}
			OMA = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
					add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
				}
				COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_decline
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
		trigger = {

			check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_OMA = 13 }

country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.5022
	title = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.5022.t
	desc = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.5022.d
	picture = GFX_political_deal
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_accept
		ai_chance = { base = 65 }
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_OMA
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_OMA = 22 }
			country_exists = OMA
			OMA = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 22 }
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
			}

			COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
				OMA = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
			}

			NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
			NOT = { has_war_with = OMA }
			OMA = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
			OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_OMA compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			OMA = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_OMA
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_OMA = 22 }
				country_exists = OMA
				OMA = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 22 }
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
				}

				COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
					OMA = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				}

				NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
				NOT = { has_war_with = OMA }
				OMA = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
				OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_OMA compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				OMA = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_OMA
				OMA = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_OMA }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
			}
			OMA = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
					add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
				}
				COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_decline
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_OMA
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_OMA = 22 }
			country_exists = OMA
			OMA = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 22 }
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_OMA
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_OMA = 22 }
					country_exists = OMA
					OMA = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
						check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 22 }
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
					}
				}
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_OMA
				OMA = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_expired
		ai_chance = { base = 0 }
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_OMA

			OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_OMA compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			OMA = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
		}

				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_OMA
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_OMA = 26 }

				NOT = { has_war_with = OMA }

				OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_OMA compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				OMA = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_OMA
				OMA = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_OMA }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
			}
			OMA = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price }

				}
				COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes

		ai_chance = { base = 65 }
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_OMA
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_OMA = 30 }
			country_exists = OMA
			OMA = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 30 }
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
			}

			COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
				OMA = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
			}

			NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
			NOT = { has_war_with = OMA }
			OMA = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
			OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_OMA compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			OMA = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_OMA
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_OMA = 30 }
				country_exists = OMA
				OMA = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 30 }
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
				}

				COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
					OMA = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				}

				NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
				NOT = { has_war_with = OMA }
				OMA = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
				OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_OMA compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				OMA = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_OMA
				OMA = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_OMA }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
			}
			OMA = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
					add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
				}
				COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_decline
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_OMA
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_OMA = 30 }
			country_exists = OMA
			OMA = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 30 }
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_OMA
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_OMA = 30 }
					country_exists = OMA
					OMA = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
						check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 30 }
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
					}
				}
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_OMA
				OMA = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_expired
		ai_chance = { base = 0 }
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_OMA

				}
			}
		}

			UAE = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
			OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_UAE compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			UAE = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_UAE
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_UAE = 19 }
				country_exists = UAE

					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting

					UAE = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				}

				NOT = { has_war_with = UAE }
				UAE = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }

			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_UAE }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
			}
			UAE = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }

				}
				COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
			}

			}

			COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
				UAE = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
			}

			NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
			NOT = { has_war_with = UAE }
			UAE = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
			OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_UAE compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			UAE = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_UAE
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_UAE = 23 }
				country_exists = UAE
				UAE = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting

					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
				}

				COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
					UAE = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				}

				NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
				NOT = { has_war_with = UAE }
				UAE = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
				OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_UAE compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				UAE = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_UAE
				UAE = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_UAE }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
			}
			UAE = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
					add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
				}
				COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
		}
	}

country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.6031
	title = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.6031.t
	desc = COLDWAR_GCC_1970.6031.d
	picture = GFX_COLDWAR_UAE_rulers_meeting_colour
	is_triggered_only = yes
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_accept
		ai_chance = { base = 65 }
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_UAE
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_UAE = 31 }
			country_exists = UAE
			UAE = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 31 }
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
			}

			COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
			OR = {
				NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
				UAE = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
			}

			NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
			NOT = { has_war_with = UAE }
			UAE = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
			OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_UAE compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
			UAE = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_UAE
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_UAE = 31 }
				country_exists = UAE
				UAE = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 31 }
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
				}

				COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes
				OR = {
					NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state }
					UAE = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				}

				NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc }
				NOT = { has_war_with = UAE }
				UAE = { COLDWAR_GCC_sovereign = yes NOT = { has_country_flag = recently_expelled_from_gcc } }
				OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_UAE compare = greater_than_or_equals } }
				UAE = { OR = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state check_variable = { var = treasury value = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price compare = greater_than_or_equals } } }
			}
			hidden_effect = {
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_UAE
				UAE = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
				set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_UAE }
				multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
				modify_treasury_effect = yes
				add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
			}
			UAE = {
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { has_idea = idea_gcc_member_state } }
					set_temp_variable = { treasury_change = COLDWAR_GCC_entry_price }
					multiply_temp_variable = { treasury_change = -1 }
					modify_treasury_effect = yes
					add_ideas = idea_gcc_member_state
				}
				COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
			}
			COLDWAR_GCC_refresh = yes
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_decline
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
		trigger = {
			has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_UAE
			check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_UAE = 31 }
			country_exists = UAE
			UAE = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 31 }
				check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
			}
		}
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_UAE
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_UAE = 31 }
					country_exists = UAE
					UAE = {
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
						has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
						check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 31 }
						check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
					}
				}
				clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_UAE
				UAE = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting }
			}
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_GCC_expired
		ai_chance = { base = 0 }
		trigger = {
			NOT = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_received_UAE
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_round_UAE = 31 }
				country_exists = UAE
				UAE = {
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_pending
					has_country_flag = COLDWAR_GCC_offer_awaiting
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_GCC_offer_round = 31 }
					check_variable = { var = COLDWAR_GCC_partner value = ROOT.id compare = equals }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
